showroom.service exits 125 (podman-compose failure) on ocpvdev01
issues.description:
h2. Problem

{{showroom.service}} fails with exit code 125 from {{showroom-start.sh}} on ocpvdev01. This is a podman-compose failure — likely SELinux or a timing issue specific to ocpvdev01.

The containers recover and start via the Ansible role directly, but the systemd service is marked as failed.

h2. Context

Reported by Prakhar Srivastava via Slack: https://redhat-internal.slack.com/archives/D07M8U1C0SE/p1776390729062779

Findings from the investigation:

* Bastion IP: 10.0.2.2 (OCP SDN internal)
* Port 80 listening on the bastion
* Local curl with correct Host header returns 200
* External via OCP Router (67.228.103.8) returns 503

Two separate bugs identified:

# OCP Route → Service → Pod routing for port 80 broken on ocpvdev01
# showroom.service exits 125 on ocpvdev01 (podman-compose error)

h2. Acceptance Criteria

* Investigate the podman-compose failure causing exit code 125
* Determine if this is SELinux, timing, or container runtime related
* Ensure showroom.service starts cleanly without relying on Ansible role fallback
* Verify fix on ocpvdev01

h2. References

* Slack thread: https://redhat-internal.slack.com/archives/D07M8U1C0SE/p1776390729062779

issues.summary: rhpds/assisted_installer wait_for_hosts module crashes on empty API response (JSONDecodeError)
issues.description:
h2. Problem

The {{wait_for_hosts}} module in the {{rhpds/assisted_installer}} Ansible collection (v0.0.9) crashes with a {{JSONDecodeError}} when the Red Hat Assisted Installer API ({{api.openshift.com}}) returns an empty response body.

This causes OCP cluster provisioning failures for the {{ocp-cluster-cnv-pools}} catalog item (and anything else using this collection for assisted installs on CNV).

h2. Root Cause

In {{plugins/modules/wait_for_hosts.py}}, the module calls:

{code:python}response = session.get(
    "https://api.openshift.com/api/assisted-install/v2/clusters/" + cluster_id,
    headers=headers,
)
if "code" in response.json():  # crashes here{code}

It does not:

# Check {{response.status_code}} before calling {{.json()}}
# Handle {{JSONDecodeError}} exceptions
# Retry on transient API failures

When the API returns an empty body (e.g. during a transient hiccup shortly after cluster creation), the module crashes immediately instead of retrying within its existing wait loop.

h2. Evidence

* *AAP2 Job*: 2582633 (failed 2026-06-22 04:37:47 UTC)
* *Catalog Item*: {{agd_v2/ocp-cluster-cnv-pools}} (component of {{agd_v2/ocp-cluster-cnv}})
* *Deployer scm_ref*: {{ocp-cnv-pool-1.2.3}}
* *Collection version*: {{rhpds/assisted_installer}} v0.0.9
* *Error*: {{requests.exceptions.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)}}

h2. Fix

Wrap the {{response.json()}} call in a try/except within the existing retry loop:

{code:python}try:
    data = response.json()
except requests.exceptions.JSONDecodeError:
    time.sleep(module.params['delay'])
    retries += 1
    continue{code}

Also add {{response.status_code}} checking before parsing JSON.

h2. Repo

https://github.com/rhpds/assisted_installer (tag v0.0.9)

File: {{plugins/modules/wait_for_hosts.py}}

h2. Links

* [https://aap2-prod-us-east-2.aap.infra.demo.redhat.com/#/jobs/2582633|https://aap2-prod-us-east-2.aap.infra.demo.redhat.com/#/jobs/2582633]
* [https://aap2-prod-us-east-2.aap.infra.demo.redhat.com/#/jobs/playbook/2582636/output|https://aap2-prod-us-east-2.aap.infra.demo.redhat.com/#/jobs/playbook/2582636/output]

Nookbag template local dev fails — antora-tabs-extension missing from antora-viewer image
issues.description:
h2. Context

Per Slack thread from @Evan Shortiss (https://redhat-internal.slack.com/archives/C04MLMA15MX/p1781071514097049), running the nookbag showroom template locally with podman using the documented command fails because the {{@andrew-jones/antora-tabs-extension}} plugin is not installed in the {{ghcr.io/juliaaano/antora-viewer}} image.

The error is:

{noformat}[06:02:26.154] FATAL (antora): Cannot find module '@andrew-jones/antora-tabs-extension'{noformat}

Removing the extension from {{site.yml}} works around the issue but breaks tab rendering.

h2. Required Actions

# Add {{@andrew-jones/antora-tabs-extension}} to the {{ghcr.io/juliaaano/antora-viewer}} image (coordinate with @Juliano), OR update the nookbag template README to document the official Antora image that includes all required plugins
# Update the nookbag template README with correct local development instructions (the sample podman command currently does not work out of the box)
# Consider documenting the official Antora image used in production as the recommended image for local development

h2. References

* Slack thread: https://redhat-internal.slack.com/archives/C04MLMA15MX/p1781071514097049

Add click to execute plugin to offical nookbag theme
issues.description:
h3. Recommendation for the Official Theme

To add the "click to execute" functionality to the official theme, you would really only need to:

1. *Add `src/js/08-execute.js`* - the self-contained execute module (194 lines). It's well-isolated with no external dependencies. The code is already compatible since it uses vanilla JS and targets the same Showroom SPA architecture.

2. *No CSS changes needed* - the official theme already has the same `code.css` styling for `.execute` blocks. The execute script applies its own inline styles dynamically anyway.

3. *No template/partial changes needed* - the script is auto-included in `site.js` by the Gulp build's `+([0-9])-*.js` glob pattern.

That's it. The rest of the differences in the user's theme are regressions compared to your official branch (older dependencies, missing accessibility features, inline SVG logo instead of image, synchronous script loading, etc.) - none of which you'd want to bring over.
